title: Inside the Dinotopia Pop-Up Book
content: TheDinotopia Pop-Up bookbrought to life scenes from the hatchery, a convoy facing off with T. rex, the hanging baskets of Treetown, and the dinosaur olympics, complete with a wonderful wobble-run.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)Paper engineering was by Intervisual, and the art was by Michael Welply, with craftspeople in Bolivia doing all the assembly work.--Dinotopia Pop-Up bookon Amazon
